outcome: success rate of treatment for PPH
number of red blood cells units transfused
cohort: 231 patients transferred for severe PPH to a tertiary care center
finding: Compared with uterine embolization and medical management, intrauterine tamponade balloon (ITB) use in a tertiary care center was associated with a lower risk of undergoing AIP for severe PPH.
mod_finding: Cesarean section during labor did not influence the risk of AIPs for patients with ITB but did so in patients who were under expectant management in the intensive care.
